readout_other: H-reflex and M-wave EMG; flexor reflex windup; hot plate withdrawal latency; NeuN immunostaining; subcutaneous temperature
direction_notes: tsFUS at the MN segment with PRF 2 kHz suppressed the H-reflex, flexor-reflex C-fibre windup and increased hot-plate withdrawal latency; at PRF 100 Hz the H-reflex showed a moderate increase. T10 and Sa targets had no effect.
safety_notes: No neuronal loss on NeuN staining 7 days after tsFUS; no signs of discomfort, vocalisation, pain or stress observed in anaesthetised or awake rats; subcutaneous temperature rise measured.

source_quotes.n_subjects: The effects of tsFUS on the spinal circuit were examined in 35 Sprague-Dawley rats (250–450 g). In some rats, in which more than one tsFUS sessions were tested, we allowed a period of at least three days between each experiment to minimize any carryover effects (Table 1). Different tsFUS parameters were tested in each session; we waited approximately 15 minutes after testing another parameter. All experiments were approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee of the Feinstein Institute.

flags.reason: 1.48 MPa given for all subsequent experiments; voltage-to-pressure calibration was in degassed water, but the paper does not say 1.48 MPa is a free-field value.
Earlier experiments used 'different pressure levels' not stated per condition; pressure not reported for DRG, T10 and Sa exposures.

Pulse duration (200 us burst) is from the Fig. 1 legend, stated for burst mode 'at different interburst intervals'; with PRF 100 Hz and 40% duty cycle 200 us would not give 40%, so it may not apply to the 100 Hz condition.
PRF 2 kHz and 100 Hz both used; PRF 100 kHz also appears once in the text (likely a typo for 100 Hz).
35 rats in total; some rats had several sessions with different parameters, and group sizes vary across experiments.
Sham stimulation is mentioned for the hot plate test and histology (sham-treated animals) but how it was produced is not described.
Spinal levels mapped by the authors to vertebrae (MN segment T13, DRG L5, T10 at T9, Sa at S2); term choice is an interpretation.
